newsitem.title: USA: Federated to sell 3 Macy's stores to Dillard.
newsitem.headline: Federated to sell 3 Macy's stores to Dillard.

text.p: Federated Department Stores Inc on Friday said it signed letter of intent to sell three Macy's stores in Houston to Dillard Department Stores Inc.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
It said the transaction, which involves stores in the Baybrook, Deerbrook and Willowbrook malls, is expected to close sometime during the second quarter of 1997.

Michael Steinberg, chairman of Federated's Macy's West operation, said the sale would allow the division to focus on its two most productive Texas stores, the Dallas Galleria and Houston Galleria, and a new store in San Antonio due to open in May.
The San Francisco-based division, with 1996 sales of $3.7 billion, operates 109 stores in the states of Arizona, California, Minnesota, Nevada, New Mexico and Texas.
